rationale: The interpreter output contains unsupported assumptions about data filtering and includes six unresolved ambiguities. These open questions must be clarified before the implementation can be considered complete.

findings.description: The interpreter assumes the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries contains the selected Condenser Type, which is not defined in the ticket.
findings.action: Clarify with the ticket owner whether the Condenser Type should be present in the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries or if a separate mapping is required.

sourceRefs.quote: When a user selects the Condenser Type and the Refrigerant from their dropdowns, we should populate the Unit Type dropdown filtered by the condenser type and the refrigerant that was selected.

If a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the system must populate the Unit Type dropdown with entries from SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant whose parent array contains the selected Refrigerant (and, as stated, the selected Condenser Type).

findings.description: The interpreter adds a rule to filter only entries where isActive is true, which is not mentioned in the ticket.
findings.action: Confirm whether inactive items should ever be shown or if they must always be excluded from the dropdowns.

sourceRefs.quote: When a user selects the Condenser Type and the Refrigerant from their dropdowns, we should populate the Unit Type dropdown filtered by the condenser type and the refrigerant that was selected.
Only entries where isActive is true should be considered for filtering.

findings.description: Unclear how the selected Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type entries, given the example parent arrays only contain refrigerants.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the role of Condenser Type in Unit Type filtering.

sourceRefs.quote: How the selected Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type entries, given the example parent arrays only contain refrigerants.

findings.description: Uncertain whether the Condenser Type appears in the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries or requires a separate mapping.
findings.action: Clarify the data model for SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant regarding inclusion of Condenser Type.

sourceRefs.quote: Whether the Condenser Type appears in the parent array of SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant entries or requires a separate mapping.

findings.description: The UI behavior when no entries match the filter criteria is not defined.
findings.action: Define the expected UI response (e.g., empty list, message, disabled dropdown) when filters yield no results.

sourceRefs.quote: What should be displayed or how the UI should behave when no entries match the filter criteria.

findings.description: It is unclear whether the isActive flag must always be enforced or if inactive items can ever be shown.
findings.action: Confirm the policy for handling entries where isActive is false.

sourceRefs.quote: Whether the isActive flag must always be enforced or if inactive items can ever be shown.

findings.description: Unclear if Unit Size filtering should also consider Condenser Type in addition to Refrigerant and Unit Type.
findings.action: Clarify whether Condenser Type is part of the Unit Size filtering criteria.

sourceRefs.quote: If the Unit Size filtering should also consider Condenser Type in addition to Refrigerant and Unit Type.

findings.description: The exact structure, pagination, and error handling of the /dropdowns API response is not defined.
findings.action: Obtain detailed API contract for /dropdowns, including response format, pagination, and error handling.
